text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Damn it...! I was so close...!
choice_data_list: Still, you put up a magnificent fight.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you very much! ...But I 
shouldn't just be satisfied with this 
result, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what was missing... Was my idea 
too plain? Or was the strategy just not 
thought through enough...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I need to review my work properly.
So that 
next time, I can draw the absolute best 
masterpiece!
choice_data_list: With that drive to improve, I'm su...
Let's have a thorough discussion a...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...? Hehe, after all, I want 
to create the most entertaining work 
possible!
choice_data_list: With that drive to improve, you'll...
Let's have a good discussion about...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I need to look over my work 
again, don't I! All right, I'll do my 
best!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! So it's a meeting for your next 
production!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Understood! If there's something I'm 
lacking, I'll face it head-on! So—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please put me through rigorous training, 
Trainer!
